instruction.text: Choose which stylistic device is represented.

atoms.a: The crowd stretched to the ends of the earth.
Oh, wonderful — another tax increase to make us all richer.
The reporter praised the new policy as foolproof, unaware that the document she held was last year’s outdated draft.
The fire station burned down during safety week.
The golden palace rose beside the starving slums.
If honesty costs so little, why is it so rare in leadership?
“Losing half the country’s power grid was… slightly inconvenient.”
The politician’s promises were so light, they couldn’t even carry a debate.

The rain gathers quietly
upon windowpanes, slides down
to meet the parched earth, never
announcing its arrival — just moving
softly into the day.
Her smile was as bright and sudden as a flash of lightning in a summer storm.
He was so hungry he could have eaten an entire grocery store, shelves and all.
The classroom was a zoo, with students roaring over the noise of the bell.
alliteration
atoms.b: Brave banners billowed beneath the ((++blazing amazing purple)) sky.

atoms.a: assonance
atoms.b: The state’s accumulation of lies could not deceive the people’s ((++eyes hearts ears)).

hint.text: The sound is the same as in lies.

atoms.b: As the riot began, the shields ((++clattered fell held)) against the pavement like thunder.

atoms.a: accumulation
atoms.b: He brought apples, oranges, pears, ((++bananas soup cake)) — everything from the market.

atoms.a: analogy
atoms.b: Reading without understanding is like eating without ((++tasting thinking sleeping)).

atoms.a: anaphora
atoms.b: We shall fight on the beaches, we shall fight on the ((++streets spot crown)), we shall fight in the fields.

atoms.a: enumeration
atoms.b: For the trip, I packed a map, compass, tent, ((++sleeping_bag window_cleaner plant)), and boots.

atoms.a: parallelism
atoms.b: They demanded justice, they demanded truth, they ((++demanded asked_for expected)) freedom.

atoms.a: repetition
atoms.b: Alone, all alone, completely ((++alone on_my_own lonely)).

atoms.a: allusion
atoms.b: The leader’s fall was swift — another ((++Icarus winner Obama)) toppled by his own pride.

hint.text:
Icarus is a mythical man who flew too close to the sun with wings made of feathers and wax.
Obama was the 44th President of the United States.
